text.answer: Fiddlesticks is a mage/support with AP-scaling magic damage. It ambushes with a channeled blink into an area of sustained damage, with damaging abilities able to fear enemies when it is unseen and out of combat. Counterplay: watch hidden approaches and move away from its damage area.
text.counterplay: Watch hidden approaches and move away from its damage area.

text.answer: A Harmless Scarecrow replaces Fiddlesticks' trinket with effigies that imitate it. Fiddlesticks can impersonate an effigy by remaining idle out of combat; from level 6, placing an effigy also summons a temporary Sweeper Drone. Counterplay: treat apparent effigies cautiously when approaching.

text.answer: Terrify lets damaging abilities fear targets when Fiddlesticks has been out of combat and unseen by the enemy team, or is impersonating an effigy. Its targeted active fears and deals magic damage based on current health; recently feared targets resist another fear but take doubled Terrify damage instead. Counterplay: maintain vision of likely ambush positions and respect its targeted fear.

text.answer: Bountiful Harvest channels tethers to nearby enemies, revealing them, dealing repeated magic damage and healing Fiddlesticks. Completing the channel adds missing-health damage at the end; an uninterrupted ending refunds part of its cooldown. Targets need not be visible to be tethered. Counterplay: interrupt the channel or move away to break your tether.
text.counterplay: Interrupt the channel or move away to break your tether.
